chunks: Ibn Abi Najran, from Muthanna, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
“If the slave kills the free man, he is handed over to the heirs of the slain; if they wish, they may kill him, and if they wish, they may enslave him.”

key_terms.أَوْلِيَاءِ: the heirs or legal guardians entitled to claim retaliation
key_terms.اسْتَعْبَدُوا: they may enslave; take him into servitude
key_terms.الْحُرَّ: the free person; the victim in this legal case
key_terms.اَلْعَبْدُ: the slave; the legal subject discussed in the ruling
key_terms.قَتَلُوا: they may kill; exercise retaliatory execution

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a slave kills a free person in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning retaliation when a slave kills a free person. It explains that the slave is delivered to the heirs of the victim, who may choose either execution or enslavement.
